name: RC-B10-0412/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It calls on China to release Gui Minhai, a Swedish publisher held since 2015, and to let him see his family, a lawyer, a doctor and Swedish officials. It also asks the European Union's diplomatic service, the European Commission and member states to keep raising his case with China, and asks China to stop censoring and jailing writers and journalists.

- What changes: nothing legally; it is a formal request to China and EU bodies.
- Who it affects: Gui Minhai, his family, and EU diplomats dealing with China.
- What happens next: EU bodies are asked to raise his case; China is asked to act.
